description: This file implements the core synchronization logic of a note-taking app, managing sync states, triggers, and communication with repository and sync service components.

classes.name: SyncEngineState
classes.description: Represents the current state of the synchronization engine, including status, last message, and timestamp of last completion.

classes.name: SyncEngine
classes.description: Manages the synchronization process between local notes and remote server, handling triggers, connectivity status, and retry logic.

methods.name: SyncEngine.syncNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate sync, handling push and pull operations, managing sync state, and scheduling retries on failure.

methods.name: SyncEngine.dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancels timers, and closes the state stream.

methods.name: SyncEngine._scheduleRetryIfOnline
methods.description: Schedules a retry of the sync process with exponential backoff if the device remains online.

methods.name: SyncEngine._emit
methods.description: Updates the internal sync state and propagates it through the state stream.
